svg.title: Green Lantern — connected circuit diagram
svg.text: Green Lantern power battery — connected wiring diagram
Dots join wires. Bridge marks cross without joining. All ground symbols connect to the common GND rail.
Set OUT to 5.0 V with a meter
+5V_REG — U1, U2 and Hall, before D1
Bypass pairs: short leads at each IC
C5 at the sensor, after the cable
D1 / D2 GPIO pull-ups: 3.3 V only
